checks.text: Typing "x^2 + y^2 = r^2" in the input field shows "x² + y² = r²" in the rendered preview.
Clicking "Clear" removes all text from both input and preview.
Typing "a \cdot b" in the input field shows "a · b" in the rendered preview.
Entering "f(x) = \frac{d}{dx}x^2" in the input field shows "f(x) = d/dx x²" in the rendered preview.
Typing "E = mc^2" in the input field shows "E = mc²" in the rendered preview.
Entering "x \in \mathbb{R}" in the input field shows "x ∈ ℝ" in the rendered preview.
Typing "a_n + a_{n+1}" in the input field shows "aₙ + aₙ₊₁" in the rendered preview.
Typing "x \to 0" in the input field shows "x → 0" in the rendered preview.
Reload keeps "x^2 + y^2 = r^2" in the input field and "x² + y² = r²" in the preview.
